prompt: A single deep-green fern clump for a RimWorld plant sprite, seen from above at a slight angle, on a transparent background. Painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, no outlines. All of the fronds grow from one base at the lower left of the clump and sweep toward the right side of the image in one shared direction, as if one stroke of a comb had swept the whole plant: the tall central fronds, the shorter left-hand fronds, and the young fiddleheads all lean and curl rightward. Each frond arcs gently to the right with natural variation in length and curvature, long fronds reaching far right, short fronds reaching a little right. The silhouette reads as a lopsided, wind-combed mass leaning right, never a spreading rosette. Small fiddleheads at the base tightly curl rightward. Strong value contrast between the pale midribs and the dark green blades carries the silhouette against any ground.

prompt: A single shin-high tuft of Dewblade, an alien grass-analog, for a top-down-leaning RimWorld plant sprite, painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, transparent background. The base of the tuft, where the leaf bases converge, touches the bottom edge of the canvas at centre, with the tuft rising from that edge and no empty canvas beneath it. Strong value and colour contrast between the grey-green blades and the pale beads carries the silhouette against the ground. No outlines.
